rules.S1: SHELL construction S1: shell port -> nearest CORE ports (2, great-circle); MODELED allocation within the shell origin's 0.60 sea outbound budget, weighted by destination observed vessel calls (IMF PortWatch registry).
rules.S2: SHELL construction S2: bidirectional shell-port peer link — up to 2 nearest shell ports within 1,500 km (escalated to the single nearest shell port when none is in range); MODELED allocation weighted by destination observed vessel calls.
rules.S3: SHELL construction S3: CORE -> shell reverse of a shell-origin hub link; share capped at 0.03 and at half the core origin's remaining outbound budget for the mode (only when >= 0.01 remains), at most 3 per core node per mode; MODELED.
rules.S4: SHELL construction S4: shell air hub -> nearest CORE air hubs (2, great-circle); MODELED equal-weight allocation within the shell origin's 0.50 air outbound budget.
rules.S5: SHELL construction S5: bidirectional shell air peer link — up to 2 nearest shell air hubs within 3,000 km (escalation as S2); MODELED equal-weight allocation.
rules.S6: SHELL construction S6: shell ground node -> nearest CORE ground node and nearest CORE port (ground mode), plus 1 nearest shell ground peer within 800 km (escalation as S2); MODELED equal-weight allocation within the shell origin's 0.50 ground outbound budget.

core.definition: Calibration-grade: capacity with a named source; may originate Ledger locks; feeds the scorecard/backtest.

shell.definition: Routing-grade: verified registry coordinates + observed activity presence; capacity ESTIMATE (basis printed in calibration.md) or NOT_PUBLISHED; never originates a Ledger lock; never feeds scorecard/backtest claims; excluded from calibration joins over CORE claims (the PortWatch join's CORE coverage set is unchanged).
